$comment: WS0 rows: settings store, tunables, the four settings toggles on the Workshop activator, and their text.

General/Settings/Damage Control.$comment: R14: extra log lines and diagnostic text. Set True only for testing.

Locales/Activators.key: DC Enable Hatch Pressure Blocking Description
Locales/Activators.English: From now on a closed hatch stays shut while the water and air pushing on one side clearly outweigh the other side. Equalize the pressure before opening it.

Locales/Activators.key: DC Disable Hatch Pressure Blocking Description
Locales/Activators.English: Hatches can be opened whatever the pressure difference across them.
Let sailors block leaks on their own

Locales/Activators.key: DC Enable Automatic Leak Blocking Description
Locales/Activators.English: Free sailors will again go and block new leaks without waiting for an order.
Stop sailors blocking leaks on their own

Locales/Activators.key: DC Disable Automatic Leak Blocking Description
Locales/Activators.English: Sailors block a leak only when you order it.
Let the crew carry the wounded to safety

Locales/Activators.key: DC Enable Automatic Wounded Carrying Description
Locales/Activators.English: Crewmen will again carry injured shipmates out of danger without waiting for an order.
Stop the crew carrying the wounded on their own

Locales/Activators.key: DC Disable Automatic Wounded Carrying Description
Locales/Activators.English: Injured crewmen stay where they fell until you send someone to help. Divers are still pulled back aboard.
Every 10 seconds the game log (output_log.txt) gets a short report of air pressure, water, leaks and hatch flows, marked [DC diag]. Changes nothing in play. Useful for bug reports.
Stop writing the [DC diag] report to the game log.
